outcome: duration of stay in the neonatal intensive care unit (NICU)
cohort: Pregnant patients diagnosed with PPROM between 24+0 and 32+0 weeks of gestation.
finding: Expectant management of PPROM at 24 to 32 gestational weeks resulted in similar neonatal outcomes compared to immediate delivery, although it was associated with higher antenatal complications.
birth_weight: smaller birth weights in expectant management group
